extraFacts.fact: Unit conversions used in these answers: 1 bar = 14.5038 psi; 1 MPa = 10 bar = about 145 psi, so 0.1 MPa is about 15 psi, 0.15 MPa about 22 psi, 0.6 MPa about 87 psi, 0.7 MPa about 101 psi (7 bar), 0.9 MPa about 130 psi (9 bar) and 1 MPa about 145 psi (10 bar). Temperature: deg C = (deg F - 32) / 1.8, so +14 deg F = -10 deg C and +122 deg F = 50 deg C. JIS nominal pipe sizes: 20A = 3/4 inch, 25A = 1 inch, 40A = 1 1/2 inch, 50A = 2 inch.
extraFacts.source: NIST Special Publication 811 (unit conversion factors); JIS B 0203 / JIS G 3452 nominal size designations

extraFacts.fact: SMC directional valve part numbers (SV, SY, SYJ, VQ, VQZ, VFR, VFS series): the first digit after the series letters is the body size (e.g. SV1000 to SV4000, SY3000 to SY9000); the next digit is the valve function: 1 = 2-position single solenoid, 2 = 2-position double solenoid, 3 = 3-position closed centre, 4 = 3-position exhaust centre, 5 = 3-position pressure centre; on SY valves A = dual 3-port N.C. + N.C., B = N.O. + N.O., C = N.C. + N.O. On plug-in SY valves the following 0 marks the plug-in (manifold) type and 2 a body-ported valve. An R after the model number (e.g. SY5101R, SY3A00R) marks an external pilot version, used where supply pressure is below the pilot minimum or for vacuum. A single-solenoid spring-return valve returns to its normal position when de-energised; a double-solenoid 2-position valve stays in its last position. Closed centre blocks all ports, exhaust centre vents both cylinder ports, pressure centre pressurises both. A spool valve has a small internal leakage, so a cylinder held by a closed-centre spool valve can creep; pilot-operated check valves at the cylinder give a firm hold.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, 5-port solenoid valves SV, SY, VQ, VQZ, VF series, How to Order and Technical Data; ISO 1219-1 graphic symbols

extraFacts.fact: SMC rated-voltage digit (the first character after the first dash on SMC solenoid valves, e.g. SV1100-5FU, VQ1101-51, SY3100-5U1, VDW23-5G-2, LVM11-5C): 1 = 100 V AC, 3 = 110 V AC, 5 = 24 V DC, 6 = 12 V DC. G in the electrical-entry position (e.g. VDW23-5G-2) is a grommet entry. An -X suffix followed by a number (e.g. -X90, -X37, -X250) marks an SMC made-to-order special. -F on SMC valves and regulators denotes a bracket; on regulators B = bracket and G = pressure gauge.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, solenoid valve How to Order sections; SMC made-to-order (-X) specifications

extraFacts.fact: SMC port and fitting codes: M5 = M5 x 0.8 thread, M3 = M3 thread; 01 = 1/8, 02 = 1/4, 03 = 3/8, 04 = 1/2, 06 = 3/4, 10 = 1, 12 = 1 1/4, 14 = 1 1/2, 20 = 2 (thread size); thread type suffix: none = Rc (BSPT taper), N = NPT, T = NPTF, F = G. One-touch (push-in) fitting codes: C3, C4, C6, C8, C10 = metric tube OD 3.2, 4, 6, 8, 10 mm; N1 = 1/8 in, N3 = 5/32 in, N7 = 1/4 in, N9 = 5/16 in, N11 = 3/8 in tube.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, valve and manifold How to Order sections (port size and thread type symbols)

extraFacts.fact: SMC manifold part numbers (SS5Y, SS3Y, SS5YJ, SS3YJ, SS5V, VV5K, VV5FR, NVV5FS): SS5 = 5-port manifold, SS3 = 3-port manifold; the following letters and digit name the valve series and size (SS5Y3 = SY3000, SS5Y5 = SY5000, SS5Y7 = SY7000, SS5Y9 = SY9000, SS3Y1 = SY100, SS3YJ5 = SYJ500, SS3YJ7 = SYJ700, SS5YJ7 = SYJ7000, SS5V1 = SV1000, VV5K3 = VK3000, VV5FR5 = VFR5000, NVV5FS3 = VFS3000); then the manifold type code (e.g. 20, 21, 31, 41, 42, 45, S41, 10FD1), the number of stations as two digits, and the A/B port code. On SV manifolds the letter after the station count gives the side for the SUP/EXH ports (U, D or B for both). Codes beginning SV1000- / SV1300- (SV series), SX3000- / SX5000- (SY series) and VVQ / VVQC (VQ, VQC series) are manifold option and spare parts. Unused manifold stations are closed with a blanking plate.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, SY / SYJ / SV / VK / VF series manifold How to Order and Manifold Options

extraFacts.fact: SMC series descriptions: LVM = compact direct-operated 2- and 3-port chemical valves in which a diaphragm isolates the fluid from the solenoid, used in analytical and medical equipment; PVQ = direct-operated proportional solenoid valve for flow control (flow varies with coil current); VEP = electro-pneumatic proportional valve, pressure control type; VEF = electro-pneumatic proportional valve, flow control type; VEX = power valve series: VEX1 pilot-operated regulators (air-operated, solenoid-piloted or manual-handle precision type) and VEX3 / VEX5 3-port and 5-port power valves; VDW = compact direct-operated 2-port (VDW10/20/30) and 3-port (VDW200/300) solenoid valves; VNA, VNB = pilot-operated (air-operated or external-pilot solenoid) 2-port process valves; AV, NAV = soft start-up valves with exhaust function; LVA = air-operated chemical valve; VK = compact 5-port solenoid valve.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue series overviews (Chemical valves, Proportional valves, Power valves, Process valves, Air preparation/soft start-up valves)

extraFacts.fact: SMC states a maximum operating pressure of 0.7 MPa (102 psi, 7 bar) for the SS5Y3, SS5Y5 and SS5Y7 / SS5Y9 SY-series manifolds, the figure given on our SS5Y3, SS5Y5 and SY7000 series manifold listings.
extraFacts.source: SMC SY series catalogue, manifold specifications

extraFacts.fact: HS (Harmonized System) classification: heading 8481 covers taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances; subheading 8481.20 = valves for oleohydraulic or pneumatic transmissions; 8481.90 = parts. US HTS 8481.20.0060 and 8481.90.9040 are national 10-digit lines within these subheadings.
extraFacts.source: WCO Harmonized System Nomenclature 2022, heading 84.81; US Harmonized Tariff Schedule chapter 84

faqs.q: What is the SMC LVM series chemical valve used for?
faqs.a: The SMC LVM series is a compact direct-operated solenoid valve for switching small flows of chemical liquids, the kind used in analytical and medical equipment. This listing carries 7 SMC part numbers, from LVM10R1-6B-1 and LVM11-5C to LVM20R3-5A, so quote the exact code when you order.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC LVM part number such as LVM11-5C?
faqs.a: In LVM11-5C the LVM prefix is the chemical valve series, 11 is SMC's body and valve-type code, and the 5 after the dash is the coil voltage, 24 V DC in SMC's usual coding (6 is 12 V DC, as in LVM10R1-6B-1). The letters and suffixes that follow, such as -Q or -X37, set the electrical entry, options and specials.

faqs.q: Which SMC LVM chemical valve models are on this listing?
faqs.a: The listing covers LVM10R1-6B-1, LVM10R3-5C, LVM11-5C, LVM11-5C-1, LVM13R-5C-X37, LVM15R3Y-5C-Q and LVM20R3-5A. The digits after LVM identify the body size and valve type, so a replacement should match the full code of the valve on the machine, including any -X special number.

faqs.q: How do I choose between SMC LVM10, LVM15 and LVM20 chemical valves?
faqs.a: Choose by the orifice, port and valve type the circuit needs rather than by the series number alone. LVM10, LVM11 and LVM13 are the smaller bodies here and LVM15 and LVM20 the larger ones; send the fluid, pressure and required flow and we confirm the right LVM model with SMC before supply.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature ratings apply to the SMC LVM chemical valve?
faqs.a: SMC publishes operating pressure, orifice and fluid temperature for each LVM model in its LVM catalogue, and the figures differ by body size and valve type. This listing does not hold a rating against each part number, so we confirm the maker's figures for your exact LVM code with the quotation.

faqs.q: Which fluids can the SMC LVM series chemical valve handle?
faqs.a: SMC designs the LVM series for chemical liquids, with a diaphragm that isolates the fluid from the solenoid so the coil and armature stay dry. Wetted body and seal materials depend on the model code, so tell us the exact chemical, concentration and temperature and we check compatibility with SMC before you order.

faqs.q: What documents come with SMC LVM series chemical valves?
faqs.a: This listing holds no certificates or declarations for the LVM range. If your equipment file needs a certificate of conformity, a material declaration for the wetted parts or a test report, name it in the enquiry and we request it from SMC with the order.

faqs.q: What fittings and tubing connect to an SMC LVM chemical valve?
faqs.a: SMC LVM valves are small-bore valves, so they are usually plumbed with fine chemical-resistant tubing and matching miniature fittings or onto a manifold base. Choose tube material for the chemical; our [tubing materials guide](/blog/pneumatic-tubing-materials-guide) compares nylon, polyurethane and fluoropolymer tube.

faqs.q: How should an SMC LVM chemical valve be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Mount the LVM valve with the flow direction SMC marks on the body, keep the line clean and flush it after aggressive chemicals so crystals do not build on the diaphragm seat. Check the coil voltage against the part number before powering it, and replace the valve if the diaphragm leaks.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC LVM and SMC VDW solenoid valves?
faqs.a: SMC LVM is a chemical valve whose isolation diaphragm keeps aggressive liquids away from the solenoid, while the [SMC VDW series](/p/smc-vdw-series-valve) is a compact general-purpose 2-way and 3-way solenoid valve for air and similar media. Pick LVM when the fluid would attack a standard valve.

faqs.q: Where are SMC LVM chemical valves shipped from?
faqs.a: We ship SMC LVM chemical valves from our Dubai warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Solenoid valves of this kind are normally classed under HS heading 8481; the country of origin depends on the SMC plant that built the valve and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you stock SMC LVM series chemical valves in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep SMC LVM series chemical valves in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the LVM part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) and we reply with price and delivery.

faqs.q: What is the SMC PVQ series proportional valve used for?
faqs.a: The SMC PVQ series is a direct-operated proportional solenoid valve whose flow rises with the coil current, used to meter air in blow, leak-test and flow-control circuits. Our listing has 7 SMC part numbers in the PVQ13, PVQ31 and PVQ33 models, all 2-position normally closed linear-motion poppet valves.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC PVQ part number such as PVQ31-5G-23-01N?
faqs.a: In PVQ31-5G-23-01N, PVQ31 is the body model, 5 is the coil voltage (24 V DC in SMC coding), G the electrical entry, 23 the orifice code and 01N the port, 1/8 NPT. The smaller PVQ13 codes end in M5, an M5 x 0.8 port, and a trailing -F or -A marks a bracket or option.

faqs.q: What port sizes do SMC PVQ13 and PVQ31 proportional valves have?
faqs.a: The PVQ13 valves on this listing (PVQ13-5L-06-M5-A, PVQ13-5L-08-M5-A, PVQ13-6M-08-M5-A) have M5 ports, while the PVQ31 and PVQ33 valves use 1/8 threads such as 01 (Rc) and 01N (NPT). PVQ31-5G-16-01 is also listed as a 1/4 base-mount size.

faqs.q: How do I size an SMC PVQ proportional valve for a flow-control job?
faqs.a: Pick the PVQ body and orifice code that passes your maximum flow at the supply pressure, then check that the coil current range suits the controller. The orifice code sits in the middle of the part number, such as 06, 08, 16, 23 or 40; our [valve sizing guide](/blog/sizing-pneumatic-valves-flow-cv) explains Cv and sonic conductance.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the SMC PVQ proportional valve have?
faqs.a: SMC rates each PVQ model and orifice separately, so the maximum operating pressure differs between PVQ13, PVQ31 and PVQ33 codes. Our size table does not carry a pressure figure for these rows, so we confirm SMC's rating and flow curve for your exact PVQ part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What media and seals suit the SMC PVQ proportional valve?
faqs.a: The PVQ valves on this listing are soft-seal poppet valves for clean, dry compressed air and inert gas. For any other gas or for oil-free duty, give us the medium with the enquiry and we check the seal and body options with SMC.

faqs.q: What compliance documents are available for SMC PVQ proportional valves?
faqs.a: No certificates or declarations are attached to this PVQ listing. If you need a certificate of conformity, a RoHS declaration or flow-test data for the valve, say so when you order and we request it from SMC.

faqs.q: What does an SMC PVQ proportional valve need to run?
faqs.a: A PVQ valve needs a current or PWM driver that matches its coil, wired through the M plug connector listed in the specification, plus filtered air upstream. Fit an air filter and regulator ahead of it from our [FRL shelf](/c/air-preparation-frl) so the flow curve stays repeatable.

faqs.q: How do you install and maintain an SMC PVQ proportional valve?
faqs.a: Mount the PVQ valve directly as the specification lists, with flow in the direction marked on the body and filtered air at the inlet. Keep dirt out of the poppet seat, since contamination shifts the flow curve; if output drifts, clean the supply and check the driver current before replacing the valve.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC PVQ and SMC VEP proportional valves?
faqs.a: SMC PVQ is a small direct-operated proportional valve that controls flow through a normally closed poppet, while the [SMC VEP series](/p/smc-vep-series-proportional-valve) is an electro-pneumatic proportional valve for controlling pressure on a larger body. Choose PVQ to meter flow, VEP to set pressure.

faqs.q: Where are SMC PVQ proportional valves shipped from?
faqs.a: We ship SMC PVQ proportional valves from our Dubai warehouse to the GCC, Africa, Asia and other export markets. They are normally classed as pneumatic valves under HS subheading 8481.20, and the country of origin follows the SMC plant that built the valve and appears on our invoice.

faqs.q: Can I buy SMC PVQ proportional valves ex-stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep SMC PVQ series proportional valves in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the PVQ part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is the SMC SV 4-way 3-position closed centre solenoid valve used for?
faqs.a: This listing covers SMC SV series 3-position closed centre solenoid valves, SV1300-5FU, SV2300-5FU, SV3300-5FU and SV4300-5FU, which stop and hold a double-acting cylinder in mid-stroke when both coils are off. They are base-mounted, internally piloted spool valves for 24 V DC.

faqs.q: What does the part number SMC SV3300-5FU mean?
faqs.a: In SV3300-5FU, SV is the series, the first 3 the body size (SV3000), the second 3 the function, a 3-position closed centre valve, and 5 the 24 V DC coil. The FU letters set the electrical entry and options, so the same suffix appears on SV1300-5FU, SV2300-5FU and SV4300-5FU.

faqs.q: Which sizes of SMC SV closed centre valve are on this listing?
faqs.a: There are four body sizes: SV1300-5FU (2 15/32" wide, 3 3/4" high), SV2300-5FU (2 13/16" x 4 15/32"), SV3300-5FU (3 1/4" x 5 1/16") and SV4300-5FU (3 3/8" x 6 15/32"). Larger bodies pass more air, so pick the size by the cylinder bore and speed you need.

faqs.q: How do I choose an SMC SV valve size for a cylinder?
faqs.a: Size the SV valve on the flow the cylinder needs at your working pressure, then choose the smallest body that delivers it: SV1000 for small bores, up to SV4000 for large bores and long hoses. Our [valve sizing guide](/blog/sizing-pneumatic-valves-flow-cv) walks through Cv and cylinder speed.

faqs.q: What is the maximum operating pressure of SMC SV1300 and SV2300 valves?
faqs.a: The size table lists 101 psi (about 7 bar) as the maximum operating pressure for SV1300-5FU and SV2300-5FU. Check the row for the larger SV3300 and SV4300 bodies before ordering, and keep the supply regulated below the valve's rating.

faqs.q: What is the SMC SV 3-position closed centre valve made of?
faqs.a: The listing gives an aluminium body and spool with rubber seals, and the valve needs no lubrication. It is for compressed air and is listed as not vacuum operable, so use a dedicated vacuum valve on suction lines.

faqs.q: What enclosure rating does the SMC SV closed centre valve carry?
faqs.a: The SV 3-position closed centre valves on this listing are given as NEMA 6 with a plug-in electrical connection and a 0.6 W coil. This listing holds no certificates; if your project needs a declaration of conformity, ask with the order and we request it from SMC.

faqs.q: What manifold does the SMC SV1300 closed centre valve mount on?
faqs.a: SV1300-5FU is base mounted, so it sits on an SV1000 manifold such as the [SMC SS5V1 series manifold](/p/smc-ss5v1-series-manifold), which supplies air and exhaust to every station. The cylinder ports and fittings are on the manifold, not the valve body.

faqs.q: Does the SMC SV closed centre valve need oiled air?
faqs.a: No. The listing states that lubrication is not required, but the air should be filtered and dry so the spool stays clean. A non-locking manual override lets you shift the valve during set-up; release it and the spring-centred spool returns to the closed centre.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC SV closed centre and exhaust centre valves?
faqs.a: In the centre position SV1300 blocks all ports so the cylinder holds its place, while the exhaust centre version vents both cylinder ports so the rod can be moved by hand. Exhaust and pressure centre SV valves are on the [SMC 5-way 3-position 5-port listing](/p/smc-solenoid-air-control-valve-5-way-3-position-5-port).

faqs.q: What HS code applies to the SMC SV 3-position closed centre valve?
faqs.a: Our listing classes these SMC SV valves under HS code 8481200060, within subheading 8481.20 for valves for pneumatic transmissions. We export them from Dubai to the GCC, Africa and Asia, and the SMC country of origin is shown on the commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you have SMC SV1300-5FU to SV4300-5FU valves in stock?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Dubai, UAE warehouse holds SMC SV series 3-position closed centre valves in stock, and we ship them worldwide with the best lead times. Send the SV part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is an SMC 5-way 2-position solenoid air control valve used for?
faqs.a: An SMC 5-way 2-position solenoid valve switches a double-acting cylinder between extend and retract through five ports: supply, two outlets and two exhausts. This listing gathers 55 SMC part numbers from the SV, SY, VQ, VQZ, VFR and VFS series in single and double solenoid versions.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC 5/2 valve code such as SY5120-5DZ-01T?
faqs.a: In SY5120-5DZ-01T, SY5 is the SY5000 size, the 1 after it is a single solenoid 2-position valve (2 would be double), 5 is the 24 V DC coil and 01T is a 1/8 NPTF port. The same function digit reads across SV, VQ and VQZ codes, so SV1200 and VQ1201 are double solenoid valves.

faqs.q: Which coil voltages are offered on SMC 5-way 2-position valves?
faqs.a: This listing holds 19 valves for 24 V DC, 8 for 12 V DC and 28 for 110 V AC. The voltage digit follows the dash: -5 is 24 V DC (VQ1101-51), -6 is 12 V DC (SV1100-6FU) and -3 is 110 V AC (VFS2210-3DZ).

faqs.q: What port sizes do the SMC SY 5-way 2-position valves on this listing have?
faqs.a: The SY valves step up with body size: SY3120-5LZ-M5 has M5 ports, SY5120-5DZ-01T 1/8 NPTF, SY7120-5DZ-02T 1/4 NPTF and SY9120-5DZ-03T 3/8 NPTF. Match the port to your tube and fittings, then check the flow with our [valve sizing guide](/blog/sizing-pneumatic-valves-flow-cv).

faqs.q: What is the maximum pressure of SMC VFS and VFR 5/2 solenoid valves?
faqs.a: The size table lists 140 psi for VFS2000 and VFS3000 valves, 145 psi (10 bar) for VFS5100-3FZ and VFS5110-3DZ, and 130 psi (about 9 bar) for VFR valves. SMC rates the SV1000, SV2000, SY, VQ and VQZ valves here at 101 psi (about 7 bar); read the row for the exact part you order.

faqs.q: What materials are SMC 5-way 2-position spool valves made from?
faqs.a: The listing specifies an aluminium body and spool with rubber seals, and the valves need no lubrication. They are for clean compressed air; filter the supply to the grade SMC asks for, as covered in our [ISO 8573-1 air quality guide](/blog/compressed-air-quality-iso-8573-1).

faqs.q: What power consumption and response time do SMC SV 5/2 valves have?
faqs.a: The listing gives 0.6 W coil power and a 10 ms response time for the SV1000 series double solenoid valve, with an ambient range of +14°F to +122°F (about -10 to 50°C). Other series on the listing have their own figures, published in SMC's catalogue.

faqs.q: Which manifolds suit the SMC SY and SV 5/2 valves on this listing?
faqs.a: SY valves mount on SS5Y manifolds of the same size, such as the [SMC SS5Y5 series manifold](/p/smc-ss5y5-series-manifold) for SY5000, and SV valves mount on SS5V1 manifolds. VQ, VQZ and VFS valves have their own SMC bases, so match the manifold series to the valve series.

faqs.q: What happens to an SMC double solenoid 5/2 valve when power is lost?
faqs.a: A double solenoid 2-position valve such as SV1200-6FU or SY5240-5LZ stays in its last position when power is lost, because no spring returns the spool. A single solenoid valve such as SV1100-6FU springs back to its normal position, so choose by how the machine must behave on a power failure.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC 5/2 and 5/3 solenoid valves?
faqs.a: A 5/2 valve has two positions, extend and retract, while a 5/3 valve adds a centre position that blocks, exhausts or pressurises the cylinder ports. The 3-position SY, SV and VQ versions are on the [SMC 5-way 3-position listing](/p/smc-solenoid-air-control-valve-5-way-3-position).

faqs.q: Where are the SMC 5-way 2-position solenoid valves on this listing made?
faqs.a: This listing gives Japan as the country of origin, and we ship the valves from our Dubai warehouse to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Pneumatic directional valves are normally classed under HS subheading 8481.20; the origin of each shipment is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you keep SMC 5-way 2-position solenoid valves in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We hold SMC 5-way 2-position solenoid valves in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the SV, SY, VQ, VQZ, VFR or VFS part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the SMC 5-way 2-position 5-port solenoid valve range on this listing?
faqs.a: It is a group of 31 SMC 5-port 2-position solenoid valves for 24 V DC, covering the SV1000 to SV4000, VQZ1000 to VQZ3000, VFR2000 and VFR3000 and VFS2000 to VFS5000 series. Each part number gives one body size and either a single or double solenoid.

faqs.q: How do you tell single from double solenoid in SMC SV1100-5FU and SV1200-5FU?
faqs.a: The digit after the body size gives the function: 1 means single solenoid, so SV1100-5FU springs back when the coil is off, and 2 means double solenoid, so SV1200-5FU holds its last position. The -5 after the dash is the 24 V DC coil.

faqs.q: What sizes of SMC SV 5-port 2-position valve are listed?
faqs.a: The SV valves come in four widths: SV1100 and SV1200 at 2 15/32", SV2100 and SV2200 at 2 13/16", SV3100 and SV3200 at 3 1/4", and SV4100 and SV4200 at 3 3/8". The smaller VQZ valves are 1 1/2" wide for tight manifolds.

faqs.q: Which SMC 5-port 2-position series should I choose: SV, VQZ, VFR or VFS?
faqs.a: Choose VQZ or SV1000 for compact, low-flow machine valves; SV2000 to SV4000 for larger cylinders on a manifold; VFR for 130 psi duty; and VFS, including VFS5100-5FZ and VFS5110-5DZ, for the highest pressure and flow here. Compare Cv with our [valve sizing guide](/blog/sizing-pneumatic-valves-flow-cv).

faqs.q: What is the operating pressure range of SMC SV and VQZ 5-port valves?
faqs.a: SMC's pressure range is 22 to 100 psi for single solenoid SV and VQZ valves such as SV1100-5FU and VQZ1151-5LO1, and 15 to 100 psi for double solenoid ones such as SV1200-5FU. Below the minimum the pilot cannot shift the spool reliably.

faqs.q: What pressure range do SMC VFR and VFS 5-port valves cover?
faqs.a: SMC gives 30 to 130 psi for single solenoid VFR valves such as VFR2100-5FZ and 15 to 130 psi for double solenoid VFR2200-5FZ. The VFS valves on this listing cover 15 to 145 psi (about 1 to 10 bar), the widest range of the group.

faqs.q: What is the body and seal material of SMC 5-port 2-position solenoid valves?
faqs.a: This listing specifies an aluminium body and spool with rubber seals and no lubrication requirement. The valves are for compressed air and are listed as not vacuum operable, so use a vacuum-rated valve from our [vacuum components shelf](/c/vacuum-components) for suction.

faqs.q: What enclosure class and response time are listed for SMC SV 5-port valves?
faqs.a: The SV1000 single solenoid valve is listed with a NEMA 6 enclosure class, an internal pilot and an 11 ms response time. This listing holds no certificates; request a declaration of conformity or other documents with the order if your project needs them.

faqs.q: What fittings connect to SMC 5-port 2-position solenoid valves?
faqs.a: Body-ported VFR and VFS valves take threaded fittings in their ports, while base-mounted SV and VQZ valves connect through the manifold's cylinder ports. Push-in fittings and exhaust silencers for the outlets are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How should SMC 5-port solenoid valves be maintained?
faqs.a: Supply filtered, dry air, keep exhaust ports fitted with silencers and check the coil voltage on the label before wiring. The valves need no oil; if a spool sticks, clean the air supply first, and use the non-locking manual override to test the valve without power.

faqs.q: What HS code is used for SMC 5-way 2-position 5-port valves?
faqs.a: Our listing gives HS code 8481200060, inside subheading 8481.20 for valves for pneumatic transmissions. We ship from Dubai to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, and the SMC country of origin is shown on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Are SMC 5-port 2-position valves available ex-stock from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We stock SMC 5-way 2-position 5-port solenoid valves at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship them worldwide with the best lead times. Send the SV, VQZ, VFR or VFS part numbers with quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is an SMC 5-way 3-position solenoid valve used for?
faqs.a: An SMC 5-way 3-position solenoid valve drives a double-acting cylinder both ways and adds a centre position for stopping, venting or pressurising the cylinder when both coils are off. This listing carries 20 part numbers from the SV, SY3000, SY5000 and VQ2000 series.

faqs.q: What do the digits 3, 4 and 5 mean in SMC codes such as SY3340, SY3440 and SY3540?
faqs.a: The digit after the body size sets the centre: 3 is closed centre (SY3340-5LZ), 4 is exhaust centre (SY3440-5LZ) and 5 is pressure centre (SY3540-5LZ). The same rule applies to SV and VQ codes, so VQ2301 is closed centre and VQ2401 is exhaust centre.

faqs.q: Which coil voltages do the SMC 5-way 3-position valves on this listing use?
faqs.a: Ten valves are 12 V DC, such as SV3300-6FU, eight are 24 V DC, such as SY5340-5LZ and VQ2301-51, and two are 110 V AC, VQ2301-31 and VQ2401-31. Order the voltage digit to match your controller output.

faqs.q: How do I choose between closed, exhaust and pressure centre SMC 5/3 valves?
faqs.a: Choose closed centre to hold a cylinder in place, exhaust centre to let the rod float and vent pressure for safe handling, and pressure centre to push both sides and balance the rod. Our [solenoid valve functions guide](/blog/solenoid-valve-functions-3-2-5-2-5-3) shows each centre symbol.

faqs.q: What is the maximum operating pressure of SMC SY and VQ 5-way 3-position valves?
faqs.a: The size table lists 101 psi (about 7 bar) for the SY3000, SY5000 and VQ2000 3-position valves and for SV1000 and SV2000 rows. Check the row for SV3000 and SV4000 parts, and regulate the supply below the rating shown.

faqs.q: What are SMC 5-way 3-position spool valves made from?
faqs.a: The listing specifies an aluminium body and spool with rubber seals, for compressed air without lubrication. Fit filtration ahead of the valve from our [FRL shelf](/c/air-preparation-frl) so the spool and pilot stay clean.

faqs.q: What response time and coil power are listed for SMC SV3000 3-position valves?
faqs.a: The listing gives a 32 ms response time and 0.6 W coil power for the SV3000 series 3-position valve, with an ambient range of +14°F to +122°F (about -10 to 50°C). The valves are internally piloted, so the supply must stay above the pilot minimum.

faqs.q: Which manifold takes the SMC SY3340 and SY5340 3-position valves?
faqs.a: SY3000 valves such as SY3340-5LZ mount on SS5Y3 manifolds and SY5000 valves such as SY5340-5LZ on SS5Y5 manifolds. The [SMC SS5Y3 series manifold](/p/smc-ss5y3-series-manifold) listing shows station counts and port options for the smaller size.

faqs.q: Can a cylinder drift on an SMC closed centre 5/3 valve?
faqs.a: Yes, a cylinder held by a closed centre spool valve can creep slowly because spool valves have a small internal leak. For a firm hold over long periods add pilot-operated check valves at the cylinder ports, and do not rely on the valve alone for personnel safety.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC SV3300-6FU and SV3400-6FU?
faqs.a: Both are SV3000 3-position valves with 12 V DC coils, but SV3300-6FU has a closed centre that blocks all ports and SV3400-6FU an exhaust centre that vents both cylinder ports. The 24 V DC versions are on the [SMC 5-way 3-position 5-port listing](/p/smc-solenoid-air-control-valve-5-way-3-position-5-port).

faqs.q: What is the SMC SV 5-way 3-position 5-port exhaust centre valve used for?
faqs.a: This listing covers SMC SV series 3-position 5-port valves for 24 V DC, SV1400 to SV4400 and SV1500 to SV4500 in -5FU form, which stop a double-acting cylinder and vent or pressurise its ports when both coils are off. They are base mounted, internally piloted spool valves.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC SV2400-5FU and SV2500-5FU?
faqs.a: The digit after the body size sets the centre position: 4 in SV2400-5FU is exhaust centre, venting both cylinder ports, and 5 in SV2500-5FU is pressure centre, supplying both. Both are SV2000 bodies with 24 V DC coils, as the -5 shows.

How do I pick the SMC SV valve size for my manifold?

faqs.q: What pressure is the SMC SV1400 and SV2400 exhaust centre valve rated for?

faqs.q: What materials and media suit the SMC SV 3-position 5-port valve?

faqs.q: What electrical rating does the SMC SV exhaust centre valve have?

faqs.q: Which manifold suits the SMC SV1400-5FU and SV1500-5FU valves?
faqs.a: SV1400-5FU and SV1500-5FU fit SV1000 manifolds such as the [SMC SS5V1 series manifold](/p/smc-ss5v1-series-manifold), which carries the supply, exhaust and cylinder ports. Larger SV2000 to SV4000 valves need the manifold of their own size.

faqs.q: Why use an exhaust centre SMC SV valve for maintenance safety?
faqs.a: An exhaust centre valve such as SV3400-5FU vents both cylinder ports when the coils are off, so trapped air is released and the rod can be moved by hand. Even so, isolate and dump the supply before servicing; our [safety and lockout valve guide](/blog/air-safety-relief-soft-start-and-lockout-valves) explains how.

faqs.q: How does the SMC SV exhaust centre valve compare with the closed centre version?
faqs.a: The SV1400 to SV4400 exhaust centre valves vent the cylinder in mid-position, while the closed centre SV versions block all ports to hold it. The closed centre valves are on the [SMC 4-way 3-position listing](/p/smc-solenoid-air-control-valve-4-way-3-position).

faqs.q: What is the SMC SS3Y1 series manifold used for?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC SS3Y1 manifold code such as SS3Y1-S41-08-M5?
faqs.a: SS3Y1 is the 3-port manifold for SY100 valves, S41 the manifold type, 08 the number of stations and M5 the outlet port, an M5 x 0.8 thread. SS3Y1-S41-03-M3 swaps in M3 ports, and SS3Y1-31-08 and SS3Y1-31-12 are the type 31 base in 8 and 12 stations.

faqs.q: How many stations do SMC SS3Y1 manifolds come in?

faqs.q: What port sizes are available on SMC SS3Y1 manifolds?
faqs.a: The outlet ports on this listing are M5 x 0.8 on the S41 and 31 types and M3 on SS3Y1-S41-03-M3, sized for the small flows of SY100 valves. Use miniature push-in fittings of the same thread from our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: What is the maximum pressure of the SMC SS3Y1 manifold?
faqs.a: SMC states 102 psi (7 bar) for the SS3Y1 manifold, the figure on the SS3Y1-S41-08-M5 row. The usable pressure is the lower of the manifold and the SY100 valves mounted on it.

faqs.q: What media can the SMC SS3Y1 manifold carry?
faqs.a: The SS3Y1 manifold is built for compressed air feeding SY100 3-port valves. Supply clean, dry air through a filter and regulator; our [FRL guide](/blog/frl-filter-regulator-lubricator-guide) explains the order and filter grades.

faqs.q: What documents can I get with an SMC SS3Y1 manifold?

faqs.q: Which valves mount on the SMC SS3Y1 manifold?
faqs.a: SS3Y1 manifolds take SMC SY100 series 3-port solenoid valves, one per station, fixed with the screws supplied with each valve. Unused stations need a blanking plate so the common supply does not leak.

faqs.q: How do you add a station to an SMC SS3Y1 manifold?
faqs.a: SS3Y1 bases are built to a fixed station count, so adding valves usually means ordering a manifold with more stations, for example moving from SS3Y1-S41-08-M5 to SS3Y1-S41-12-M5. Specify spare stations with blanking plates at the design stage.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC SS3Y1 and SS3YJ5 manifolds?
faqs.a: SS3Y1 is the manifold for the compact SY100 3-port valve with M5 or M3 outlets, while the [SMC SS3YJ5 series manifold](/p/smc-ss3yj5-series-manifold) is for the SYJ500 3-port valve with 1/8 NPTF or push-in outlets. Choose by the valve series already on the machine.

faqs.q: What does the SMC part number SS3YJ5-41-05-01T mean?

faqs.q: How many stations are available on SMC SS3YJ5 manifolds?

faqs.q: Which outlet ports do SMC SS3YJ5 manifolds have?
faqs.a: Most SS3YJ5 manifolds here have 1/8 NPTF outlet ports (01T), and SS3YJ5-41R-02-N7T has built-in push-in fittings for 1/4" tube. Use threaded fittings and tube from our [pneumatic tubing shelf](/c/pneumatic-tubing) for the threaded versions.

faqs.q: What pressure is the SMC SS3YJ5 manifold rated for?
faqs.a: SMC states 102 psi (7 bar) for the SS3YJ5 manifold, shown on the SS3YJ5-41-04-01T row. The circuit is limited by the lower of the manifold rating and the SYJ500 valves fitted to it.

faqs.q: Can the SMC SS3YJ5 manifold be used with lubricated air?
faqs.a: The SS3YJ5 manifold carries compressed air to SYJ500 valves; dry, filtered air is the normal supply. If the plant runs lubricated air, keep it lubricated consistently, because oil washes out the factory grease and the valves then need oil permanently.

faqs.q: Which thread standard do SMC SS3YJ5 manifolds use?
faqs.a: The T at the end of SS3YJ5 codes such as SS3YJ5-41-07-01T marks NPTF threads, the inch taper thread used in North America. Rc or G threaded versions carry a different suffix, so state the thread your fittings use when ordering.

faqs.q: Which valves fit the SMC SS3YJ5 manifold?
faqs.a: SS3YJ5 manifolds take SMC SYJ500 series 3-port solenoid valves, one per station. Blank any unused station with an SMC blanking plate, and fit silencers on the exhaust ports from our [fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How do you replace a valve on an SMC SS3YJ5 manifold?
faqs.a: Shut off and vent the supply, unplug the coil, remove the valve's mounting screws and lift it off, then fit the new SYJ500 valve with a new gasket. The outlet tubing stays connected to the manifold, so the piping does not have to be disturbed.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC SS3YJ5 and SS3YJ7 manifolds?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC SS3YJ7 manifold code such as SS3YJ7-42-06-N9T?

faqs.q: What station counts are available on SMC SS3YJ7 manifolds?

faqs.q: Which outlet options do SMC SS3YJ7 manifolds offer?

faqs.q: What pressure can the SMC SS3YJ7 manifold be used at?
faqs.a: This listing does not give a pressure figure for the SS3YJ7 manifold, so we confirm SMC's rating for your exact code with the quotation. In service, the limit is the lower of the manifold and the SYJ700 valves fitted to it.

faqs.q: What air quality does an SMC SS3YJ7 manifold need?
faqs.a: Feed the SS3YJ7 manifold with filtered, dry compressed air, since dirt and water reach every SYJ700 valve on the bar. Our [compressed air quality guide](/blog/compressed-air-quality-iso-8573-1) explains the ISO 8573-1 classes and where to remove water.

faqs.q: What thread standard is used on SMC SS3YJ7 manifolds?
faqs.a: The T suffix on codes such as SS3YJ7-42-10-N9T and SS3YJ7-20-03-00T marks NPTF threads. If your plant uses Rc or G threads, say so with the order and we confirm the matching SMC code.

faqs.q: What tubing suits the push-in outlets on SMC SS3YJ7 manifolds?
faqs.a: N7 outlets take 1/4" OD tube and N9 outlets 5/16" OD tube, so use inch tubing rather than 6 mm or 8 mm metric tube. Inch nylon and polyurethane tube is on our [pneumatic tubing shelf](/c/pneumatic-tubing).

faqs.q: How do you service an SMC SS3YJ7 valve manifold?
faqs.a: Vent the supply before removing any SYJ700 valve, replace gaskets when a valve comes off, and check that blanking plates on unused stations are tight. Cut push-in tube square and push it fully home, then pull-test each tube before restoring air.

faqs.q: What are the SMC SY3A00, SY3B00 and SY3C00 valves?

faqs.q: Which SMC SY3000 function should I order for a double-acting cylinder?

faqs.q: What operating pressure does the SMC SY3000 valve need?

faqs.q: How much power does an SMC SY3000 solenoid valve use?

faqs.q: Which thread standard and options are listed for the SMC SY3000 valve?

faqs.q: What does the SMC SY3000 plug-in valve connect to?

faqs.q: How do you test an SMC SY3000 valve without power?

faqs.q: When do I need an external pilot SMC SY5000 valve such as SY5101R-5U1?

faqs.q: What is the maximum operating pressure of the SMC SY5000 valve?

faqs.q: What is the SMC VDW series solenoid valve used for?
faqs.a: The SMC VDW series is a compact direct-operated solenoid valve, made as a 2-way valve (VDW10, VDW20 and VDW30 bodies) and a 3-way valve (VDW250 and VDW350), for switching small flows of air. This listing has 32 SMC part numbers, all normally closed single units.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC VDW code such as VDW350-5G-4-02N?
faqs.a: VDW350 is the 3-way body, 5 the 24 V DC coil, G the grommet electrical entry and 4 SMC's orifice code, while 02N is a 1/4 NPT port. VDW23-6G-3-L has a 12 V DC coil and VDW250-3G-1-01N-Q a 110 V AC coil.

faqs.q: What port sizes do SMC VDW valves have?
faqs.a: The VDW valves here have M5 ports (VDW11-5G-2-M5, VDW250-5G-2-M5-A), 1/8 NPT (01N, as in VDW21-5G-1-01N), 1/4 NPT (02N, as in VDW350-5G-4-02N) and G 1/8 (01F) ports. The listing's NPT 1/8 option matches US-style fittings.

faqs.q: Should I choose a 2-way or 3-way SMC VDW valve?
faqs.a: Choose a 2-way VDW valve, such as VDW21 or VDW31, to open and shut a line, and a 3-way VDW250 or VDW350 to pressurise and then exhaust a small actuator or pilot port. Our [solenoid valve functions guide](/blog/solenoid-valve-functions-3-2-5-2-5-3) shows the port layouts.

faqs.q: What pressure can an SMC VDW solenoid valve switch?

faqs.q: Is the SMC VDW valve suitable for deionised water or oil-free duty?

faqs.q: Which electrical entry is listed for SMC VDW valves?

faqs.q: What fittings connect to SMC VDW solenoid valves?

faqs.q: How do you install an SMC VDW solenoid valve?

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC VDW21 and VDW250 valves?

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC VEP code such as VEP3121-1-03N?

faqs.q: What port sizes do SMC VEP proportional valves have?
